title: Finite-stage object model on one affine chart
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a functor, and $c$ a limit cone of $R^{\mathrm{op}}\circ\operatorname{Spec}$ with affine vertex $S$. Fix $i\in I$ and a morphism $f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. Put $X=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}S$ and $X_j=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)$ [def-pc-base-change]. Let $M$ be a finitely presented quasi-coherent module on $X$ [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $V$ be an open cover of $X_i$, and fix an index $a$ whose chart $V_a$ is affine. There is $j\geq i$ such that the chart $U_a= X_j\times_{X_i}V_a$ carries a finitely presented quasi-coherent module $N$ whose pullback along $X\times_{X_j}U_a\to U_a$ is isomorphic to the pullback of $M$ along $X\times_{X_j}U_a\to X$. No finiteness assumption on $V$ or on $f$ is made, and no overlap maps are asserted.

proof.text: Descend the finitely presented algebraic sections module on the iterated affine chart to a stage.

Prove stage and limit charts affine using stability of affine morphisms under base change. Pullback preserves quasicoherence. Realize the algebraic model as a finitely presented quasicoherent sheaf and lift the sections comparison to its pullback isomorphism.

theorem exists_finitePresentation_affine_chart_object_models
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    (M : (pullback f (c.π.app (op i))).Modules)
    (hM : M.IsFinitePresentation) (hMq : M.IsQuasicoherent)
    (V : Xi.OpenCover.{u}) (a : V.I₀) (ha : IsAffine (V.X a)) :
    ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j),
      let U : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).OpenCover.{u} :=
        V.pullback₁ (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
      let p := baseChangeMap f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
        (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))
      ∃ N : (U.X a).Modules,
        N.IsFinitePresentation ∧ N.IsQuasicoherent ∧
        Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom p a)).obj N ≅
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((U.pullback₁ p).f a)).obj M)
